The '''Vish sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It bordered [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell]], [[Quess sector/Legends|Quess]], [[Mulgard sector/Legends|Mulgard]], [[Tyus sector/Legends|Tyus]], [[Druess sector/Legends|Druess]], and [[Vilonis sector/Legends|Vilonis sectors]].
